headline: A former model home with vaulted living spaces.
introduction: The 2,192-square-foot plan includes four bedrooms, two and a half bathrooms, connected living and family rooms, and an eat-in kitchen. Owned solar, an EV-ready two-car garage, and private outdoor areas add practical flexibility.

sections.title: Living and family rooms, connected
body: Vaulted ceilings and tall windows bring natural light into the living room. A dual-sided fireplace connects the living and family rooms, and built-in cabinetry adds practical storage.

sections.title: An eat-in kitchen with patio access
body: The kitchen includes granite countertops, a center island, cabinet storage, and an eat-in dining area. A sliding glass door opens to the patio.

sections.title: Private outdoor areas
body: The property includes a private courtyard, a rear patio with a pergola, and a fenced side yard. Mature landscaping provides shade around the patio.

neighborhood.title: Parks, shopping, and BART
neighborhood.introduction: The Stoneridge Place community includes a pool, spa, and neighborhood park. Amaral Park, Pacific Pearl shopping center, and Dublin / Pleasanton BART are nearby. Route estimates below should be independently verified.

highlights.title: Amaral Park
highlights.body: A mapped walking route is approximately half a mile. City materials identify playgrounds, picnic areas, ball backstops, and basketball courts.

highlights.title: Pacific Pearl
highlights.body: Approximately 0.8 driving mile by a mapped route, with a current mix of grocery, dining, and everyday services.

highlights.title: Dublin / Pleasanton BART
highlights.body: Approximately 3.1 driving miles by a mapped route, with local and regional transit connections.
